task_completion.description: Create the 'SectorLight' directory in the correct path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or terminal window showing the directory path '/opt/bridgecommand/Models/Othership/SectorLight' exists.

task_completion.description: Create and configure 'boat.ini' with the specified Red and White sectors.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor showing 'boat.ini' containing sector definitions: Red (260 to 280) and White (280 to 260/0) with a range of at least 2.0.
A file manager or terminal window showing the directory path '/opt/bridgecommand/Scenarios/Sector_Light_Test/' exists.

task_completion.description: Create the required .ini files for the scenario (environment, ownship, othership).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file listing or editor showing 'environment.ini', 'ownship.ini', and 'othership.ini' within the Sector_Light_Test folder.

task_completion.description: Place the 'SectorLight' model in the othership.ini file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor showing 'othership.ini' referencing the 'SectorLight' model at a specific coordinate.

task_completion.description: Launch Bridge Command and verify the Red light is visible from the Own Ship's position.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Bridge Command simulation window showing a Red light visible from the bridge/viewpoint, with the Own Ship positioned at a bearing of approximately 270° from the light source.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually created files rather than just viewing existing ones.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'Save' dialog in a text editor or 'touch/mkdir' commands in a terminal.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually ran the Bridge Command application to test the scenario.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots of the Bridge Command splash screen or scenario selection menu showing 'Sector_Light_Test'.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't just display a static image of a red light.
integrity.visual_evidence: The simulation UI (compass, radar, or HUD) should show dynamic data or coordinates consistent with the scenario setup.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The model must be named 'SectorLight' and located in '/opt/bridgecommand/Models/Othership/SectorLight'. The 'boat.ini' must define a Red sector from 260 to 280 degrees and a White sector from 280 to 260 degrees (passing through 0/360). Range must be >= 2.0 nm. The verification scenario is at '/opt/bridgecommand/Scenarios/Sector_Light_Test/'. To see the Red light, the Own Ship must be at a bearing of ~270 degrees from the SectorLight.
